scope.timing: Harness post-prefill decode interval; fixed output count includes the first token, matching mlx_lm.benchmark convention.
scope.raw_projection: Exact trial timings, output IDs and MTP counters. Unrelated model telemetry and internal paths are omitted. Original artifact digests retained.
scope.reference: mlx_lm.benchmark uses the same random prompt token hash; it cannot accept the real chat-template suite. Reference trials are diagnostic controls, not a performance promotion.
